mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.department, u.position, u.profile_image_url, true AS is_following FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.following_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT u.id, u.name, u.department, u.position, u.profile_image_url, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM follows f2 WHERE f2.follower_id = #{userId} AND f2.following_id = u.id ) AS is_following FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.follower_id WHERE f.following_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
